applicationProcess.process_md:
> **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:**

**Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/)
**Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number &amp; password. Click on ‘Submit’.
**Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile.
> **Login to Apply for the Scheme:**

**Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/)
**Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button.
**Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list”, and a list of schemes will appear on the screen.
**Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”.
**Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on &quot;Submit&quot;.
> **Track Your Service Online:**


  - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/).  - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx).
> **Track Your Service Through SMS:**


  - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application.  - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL&lt;space&gt;&lt;Application ID/Ticket No.&gt; and send to 9954699899 to track your application.
> **Contact Us:**

**Helpline:** 0172-3968400
**Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in
> **Note:** 

> **Govt. Charges:** No Fee 

> **Service Charges:** ₹ 10 

> **Atal Seva Kendra Service Charges:**  ₹ 10

basicDetails.schemeName: Subsidy on Rehri alongwith (Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensil etc.) for the Fish/Fish Product Sale

children.text: The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
The applicant's age should be a minimum of 18 years.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The applicant's age should be a minimum of 18 years.

children.text: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided for the purchase of a Rehri (Handcart) along with essential items such as stove, gas chulha, utensils, etc., for selling fish or fish products.
A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- will be granted, amounting to ₹36,000/- per beneficiary.

A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- will be granted, amounting to ₹36,000/- per beneficiary.

children.text: The scheme “Subsidy on Rehri along with Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensils, etc. for Sale of Fish/Fish Products” is implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste fish farmers for the purchase of a Rehri (handcart) equipped with stove, gas chulha, utensils, and other essentials for selling fish and fish products. A 60% subsidy is provided on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- per beneficiary.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme “Subsidy on Rehri along with Stove, Gas Chulha, Utensils, etc. for Sale of Fish/Fish Products” is implemented by the Fisheries Department, Government of Haryana. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste fish farmers for the purchase of a Rehri (handcart) equipped with stove, gas chulha, utensils, and other essentials for selling fish and fish products. A 60% subsidy is provided on the total project cost of ₹60,000/- per beneficiary.

children.text: The applicant should not be a Government/Semi-Government employee.
